text:
jamie: Heads up — need a quick decision on the new 'Performance Lane' packaging for Q2 launch. Open trade-offs: per-route throughput caps vs. a purchasable burst-credit add-on. Customer asks show bursts > reserved for short windows.

sara: customer example: wants guaranteed 50 rps for 2 routes + burst to 150 rps for ~5 mins during batch jobs. asking whether to model as add-on credits or a hard cap SLA.

ivan: finance preference: committed baseline + prepaid burst credits. avoid hard SLAs unless there's a heavy premium. suggest softcap + overage priced to protect revenue.

micah: PMM note — we should aim to position it as a simple add-on: "Performance Lane + Burst Credits". Sales needs predictable messaging (examples, calcs).

jamie: quick proposal to discuss: base tier = 20 rps/route, Performance add-on = +30 rps/route, softcap enforces auto-throttle at 2x baseline by default, customers can buy Burst Credits to immediately raise the softcap for short intervals.

priya: legal flagged that we can't promise 2x without capacity commitments. need explicit "best-effort" language and clear fallback policy in contracts. also want a clause for capacity preemption to protect other customers.

pricing-bot: Auto-check: SOW template missing model_variant_fallback_clause and surge_pricing_table. Ticket created if not added.

ivan: practical trade: if softcap is best-effort, overage multiplier should be >= 2x (finance prefers 3x) to disincentivize uncommitted spikes and cover cost. also need minimums for on-demand purchases.

micah: launch gating proposal: require 1) perf benchmark: p95 latency under softcap < 200ms on hosted default model, 2) pricing docs + buyer kit + example calcs, 3) two pilot customers with explicit entitlement workflows validated.

sara: for GTM we'll need a demo kit + CSM playbook showing entitlement, alerting, and manual credit purchase flow. Sales also wants an FAQ around throttling behavior.

jamie: action items (target: decision by Fri EOD): ivan draft surge multiplier + example overage calc, priya propose contract wording, eng to mock throttling behavior and failure mode (fallback to lower-tier model or queue). I'll own pilot recruitment with @sara.

priya: suggested contract snippet for review: ```We provide burst capacity on a best-effort basis. Customer may purchase Burst Credits to increase concurrent request capacity for a limited duration. Redwood reserves the right to throttle or preempt burst allocations to ensure platform stability and fairness across customers.```

pricing-bot: Created ticket IN-4321 and linked surge-multiplier-prod-doc.

ivan: posted a sample calc in thread (wip): base monthly = $BASE + Performance add-on $Y per route. Burst Credits sold in packs; surge price = 3x base per-credit. Spreadsheet link (internal) coming. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

micah: +1 on the three gating checks. Also request telemetry hooks: daily usage windows, alerting when softcap > 80% sustained for 10m, and auto-notifications when credits drop below threshold.

jamie: OK. Sync with eng tomorrow 9am PT to walk behavior prototypes. @sara please loop in two pilot accounts to validate entitlement flow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
